strings.en: I can do it too... I'll show you!
I won't let you... go any further!
If this really is.../　a fight that can't be avoided!
Bullet, leave it to me and RyuKoOh!
Crystal Dragoon!/　RyuKoOh and I will be your opponents!
The Blue Dragon will strike down the evil dragon!
There's no turning back! Let's go, Bullet!
Right! Let's take down the XN-L here!
Exbein Boxer, I'm counting on you!
Jua-Mu, I won't let you have your way!
Is it more than just obsession/　driving that man...?
We have our reasons not to back down too!
Fighting just for your own enjoyment...!
It's a Raftclans... I have to give it everything!
I have to watch the Raftclans's reach...!
If you'd turn your blade on Her Highness...!
Karo-Ran, I'll put a stop to your schemes!
I won't hand Her Highness over to you!
Gu-Landon.../　I'll stop you no matter what!
This strange feeling I get/　from that pilot...!
I have to be careful not to/　get caught up in his pace...!
To think they'd bring out something like that...!
I have to watch out for that scythe...!
I won't let you have the Cross Gate!
I won't let you do as you please/　with the Cross Gate any longer!
I won't be fooled by that appearance...!
I have to be careful attacking Debudedabide...!
He can control Zovorg units too...!
I won't let the Yokijin be used!
Even against a dragon, I won't flinch!
I can't let the Skull Knight do as it likes!
The Skull Knight... but why the Kansai dialect?
This battle won't end unless we destroy that!
Giving it my all! To protect the Earth!
The final battle... I can't lose here!
Wiping out what you're meant to protect...!/　Even if you're set on it, we'll stop you!
The power I've been given.../　I'll use it to defeat you!
XN-L! We'll shatter/　that twisted mission of yours!
I'm used to fighting that type...!
If they're still meddling with our planet...!
No matter how many times you/　come to the Earth Sphere!
We can't let the Golaikunru/　do as they please with the Earth...!
I won't let the Golaikunru have their way!
I have to watch out for that Raig-Geios...!
I won't let you near those two units!
I won't let the Fury do as they please!
Thorn confirmed... I need to be cautious.
All I can do now is run...!
I sense something like a grudge...!
I have to thin out the Lamaris...!
I can't let even one of them remain!
We can't leave the Lamaris Kaana/　alone!
I have to defeat the Lamaris Kaana quickly...!
Even against an Ida type, I won't retreat a step!
The reason Ares Geist came here...!
I have to buy time for Arieil...!
I have to move Ares Geist out of there...!
Staying on the defensive won't cut it!
I can come through when it counts too!
I can't let something/　like this break me!
Ah! I-If I take another hit...!
I won't give up yet!/　Everyone else is still fighting!
Kyaaah!/　At this rate, I'll be shot down!
We've gotten through things like this/　before, after all!
Don't give up! There's still a chance!!
Stay calm and read the enemy's moves!
The G-Grungust took/　this much damage...!?
Ngh!? Are you still okay, Type-3...!?
If he takes the Cross Gate,/　something even worse will happen!
If we keep fighting like this, this ship will...!
No matter what power the XN-L has,/　I can't back down here...!
I can still handle this much!
It's fine. I can still fight like this...
I-I won't let you do any more!
I can't start whining/　over something like this!
I can do it too.../　I'll handle this much somehow!
Ahh!/　Th-That was a direct hit...!
Kyaa!/　Ah... The Grungust protected me...?
Thank goodness.../　You're still okay, Type-2?
At this rate, Jua-Mu will overpower us...!
S-So this is a knight's true strength...!
I can't deal with it/　the same way as the other Raftclans...!
I have to stop the Zee-Gadin somehow...!
If I waste time here, the Cross Gate...!
I have to pull the Floraga/　away from the Cross Gate...!
I can't let Debudedabide confuse me...!
Ugh, the Skull Knight's reading my moves!
Crystal Dragoon, I'm not done yet!
So big, yet it aims so accurately...!
I can't keep up with Thorn's movements...?!
Ugh! I can't stop the Raftclans...?!
It's too fast, I can't catch it...!
If I dawdle, their numbers will grow...!
If we don't purify them, this place...!
That Kaana type... it's getting stronger...?!
I knew it was more powerful/　than the other Lamaris...!
Its attack patterns are harder to read than before...!
This much is nothing, I'm fine!
Thank goodness.../　The damage is lighter than I thought.
I may not look it,/　but I've trained a bit, you know.
At this rate,/　Bullet's going to laugh at me...
Oh no, I couldn't dodge it...!
Th-The unit's so heavy.../　I couldn't dodge it...?
I'm sorry, Type-2.../　It's because I couldn't pilot you well...
The Type-2 should be fine with this much.
I can't let his momentum swallow me...!
That Raftclans is faster than the other types...!
Ugh! I have to stop the Zee-Gadin quickly...!
I have to get out of his range...!
I have to stop the Floraga quickly...!
I can't let Debudedabide get carried away...!
I couldn't read/　the Crystal Dragoon's moves...!
I couldn't shake off the Skull Knight...!
I can't let the XN-L overpower us...!
If we lose here, our Earth will...!
Stay calm and deal with the Raftclans...!
If I dawdle, I'll be surrounded!
T-To attack with a move like that!
I couldn't read/　the Kaana type's moves...!
I can't let that Lamaris get activated!
I can't let malice swallow me...!
I have to seal Ares Geist's movements...!
I can't cause trouble for everyone!
Here comes the next one! Intercept it!
Keep it up on the next one!
Stay sharp, the next one's coming soon!
Yeah, they can't keep up with us.
I owe that to the Grungust.
Not as fast as a Raftclans...!
I can't lose here! Not ever!
No matter what energy you use!
Whatever arts you use, they're meaningless/　if they can't reach me!
If my opponent's a dragon, I can't lose!
The Skull Knight is fast, but I can handle it!
Even Thorn, if I watch its moves closely...!
I'll see through even the Raftclans!
Even I could read that sword...!
I mustn't let it possess me...!
I won't be fooled by those moves...!
I won't be caught by malice!
Bigger means its moves are easier to read.
It's slower than the Kaana type!
It's faster than before, but I can read it!
I won't lose to a Yokijin!
I mean, I can see its movements.
Stay sharp, here comes the next one!
No, it's because you're with me, Bullet...
Yeah, we can dodge the next one too!
Looks like it pulled back for now.
We should keep more distance from it!
I won't get within that scythe's reach!
I-I'd rather not see that up close...
I won't go down that easily!
I'm glad we had the Jammer...
Huh? What!? I can't do anything...?
Oh no...! I lost sight of it...
I won't always be the one getting saved!
Leave the rest to me, Rio!
Rio, you're really giving it your all...!
Ryoto made an opening for me...!
Tasuku, leave the rest to me!
Leona, you might not need/　my help, but...
Yuuki, leave the rest to me!
Lieutenant Kyosuke, I'll back you up!
Masaki, leave the rest to me!
Rishu-sensei, leave the rest to me!
If Bullet and I work together...!
Bullet, leave the rest to me!
Kota, leave the rest to me!
Fiona, leave the rest to me!
Arieil, leave the rest to me!
Lieutenant Hugo, I'll back you up!
Josh, leave the rest to me!
Touma, leave the rest to me!
Leave the rest to me, Touya.
Akimi, I'll take it from here!
Moving to back up Soul Saber!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
I don't want to just be protected!
I have to do something here!
Michiru, aren't you going to dodge?!
So what if they outnumber us!
Thunder Emperor, come smite my foes!/　Swift as the law commands!/　Decree! Decree! Decree!!
Sever all evil, banish all spirits!/　Swift as the law commands!/　Decree! Decree! Decree! Decree!!
Sacred mountain of the divine land!
Deadly strike!/　Dragon King Mountain Breaker!!
Bullet, RyuKoOh, KoRyuOh!/　Lend me your strength!
Four hearts as one! Undivided will!
What matters isn't an unbreakable sword!
Invincible Azure Dragon!/　Four hearts as one!
Jaws of thunder and fire, strike my foe!!
Then I'll use E-Mode... Here I go!
At this range... it should work!
It's in my sights... Here I go!
Just defending isn't enough...! I have to attack!
I may not be as good at this/　as Bullet, but...!
Light that banishes evil, strike the enemy!!
No matter how tough the armor!
Can I really handle this weapon...?
But right now, I have to do this...!
Two baleful stars in the heavens!
With the Raptor and Bison combination!
This is the Type-3's finishing sword!
I have to catch it right!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
An evil star in the heavens,/　a pure star on the earth...!
No one can stop Type-2's sword!
